corrections.proposed: Remove Airfield Hill as a name for this tower; attach it to the Edgartown temporary-tower site (c.1950)
corrections.why: Forest Lookouts lists Airfield Hill in Edgartown as the site of a c.1950 temporary tower, while NHLR places the present tower in the Town of West Tisbury at its own coordinates

notes_for_editor: Build history rests mainly on the NHLR, with the Forest Lookouts index adding the c.1950 temporary tower. The Mass.gov Section 15 report shows no date in the text read; it calls the tower active but does not describe access or staffing. Search snippets (not opened) from the Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts chapter and a Hiking for Patches group post give a July 1950 build date for the West Tisbury tower and a 1930 first Edgartown tower, which conflicts with the NHLR's 1917 original. Worth checking if those pages can be opened.
